title: Wrecks carrying liquor, including wine from the 1600s

tellings.quote: We found also one of the oldest wine in the world from 1600. Wow.

plain: Dennis Asberg, a Swedish treasure hunter who searches shipwrecks in the Baltic Sea between Sweden and Finland with his partner Peter Lindberg, tells this on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels. He says that around 2005 their team found wrecks carrying liquor, including one of the oldest wines in the world, dating from the 1600s. He tells it to show the team's record of real finds in the same waters where they also report a strange object on the seafloor.
